overview: A personal writing app to collect blogs, notes, and diaries with a rich text editor, a built-in style checker, and optional public publishing to a shared feed.
features: Create and edit blog, note, and diary entries with a rich text editor
Tag-based organization with search and filtering
Built-in style checker that reviews drafts for clarity and readability
Publish entries to a shared public feed readable by anyone
Private entries protected by Internet Identity sign-in
